title: One-Line Drawing: Graph Generation Algorithms and Difficulty Scaling
subtitle: Deep dive into the mechanics of one-line drawing puzzles: using Euler path logic to validate solvability and controlling node degrees to generate unsolvable or single-solution levels. Systematically explains how branching points and loops quantify difficulty, demonstrating how algorithms dynamically add misleading edges to boost challenge. Readers will master graph theory applications in level generation and learn to build playable, clearly tiered puzzles.
